title: Concept: bcrypt with low cost (go) — review required
description: In go, GenerateFromPasswords*([^)]*,s*[0-9]b sets bcrypt's cost factor. Each increment doubles attacker work; single-digit costs fall quickly. The remedy is raising to cost 12+.
applicability: go password hashing; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cheap offline cracking; LOW severity (single-digit costs are usually tests).
